description: HTML source file for a web-based database visualizer interface, including embedded CSS styling and JavaScript logic for dynamic data fetching and UI interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database and loads table data.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the tables for a specific database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders the data of a specific table, limited to 50 records.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data, including handling wide content.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates individual cell HTML, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expand functionality.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expanded view of cell content for long strings or objects.
